overview: They dreamed of a better world, but now they're living a nightmare. Neo-Western and love story in Patagonia.
title: Ahi Afuera

overview: Broadcasting recorded plays on television over two or three days, during public performances at the Marigny theater, on the Champs-Élysées, or sometimes at the Édouard-VII theater .
title: Au théâtre ce soir

overview: A Taste of History is a TV cooking series that explores America's culinary beginnings from the birthplace of American cuisine. This series brings America's history to life and makes it vibrant as we step back in time and get to know the founders of our country through the food they ate and the recipes they prepared.
title: A Taste of History

overview: Led by Emmy Award-winning journalist Paula Zahn, On the Case features in-depth interviews and original reporting that go beyond the headlines in search of fascinating mysteries from within our nation's justice system. Each episode is highlighted by Zahn's riveting exclusive interviews, which draw out different viewpoints from the people personally connected to tragedies that rocked their local community and the investigations that attempted to piece together the truth On the Case with Paula Zahn.
title: On the Case with Paula Zahn

overview: Flirty Dancing is part performance, part blind date, and all about romantic chemistry. In the show, complete strangers are each taught half of a dance routine, then meet for the first time on a blind date at a breathtaking location, where they will then dance together without saying a word. In this romantic approach to dating, these singles will push themselves out of their comfort zones in the hope of being swept off their feet, rather than swept to the left or right on a phone.
title: Flirty Dancing

overview: Six Norwegian celebrities meet the trolls who hate them on social media face to face.
title: Haterne

overview: Ninth House is set at an alternate Yale, where the secret societies guard dangerous, magical secrets and ghosts haunt the campus.
title: Ninth House

overview: Masters of the Air follows the men of the 100th Bomb Group (the "Bloody Hundredth") as they conduct perilous bombing raids over Nazi Germany and grapple with the frigid conditions, lack of oxygen and sheer terror of combat conducted at 25,000 feet in the air. Portraying the psychological and emotional price paid by these young men as they helped destroy the horror of Hitler's Third Reich, is at the heart of Masters of the Air. Some were shot down and captured; some were wounded or killed. And some were lucky enough to make it home. Regardless of individual fate, a toll was exacted on them all.
title: Masters of the Air

overview: Loretta Fontaine and Vickilyn Fontaine Clayton, two black sisters living in a small Oklahoma town who attempt to raise their rambunctious teenage niece, Toby Reed (played by La Verne Anderson) after her parents are killed in a car accident. Vicklyn runs a curio shop called Small World Miniatures, and Loretta is a hostess at Cafe Jacques. All three live at 731 Oakwood Avenue in Ponca City.
title: Sugar and Spice

overview: Cameras film around the clock in some of Britain's busiest A&E departments, where stories of life, love and loss unfold every day
title: 24 Hours in A&E

overview: Je is a girl that has luck all the time, while Not has bad luck. One night these two, came across each other and their luck reverses. Je is unhappy about this settlement, so she's planning to get her luck back.
title: One Night Steal

overview: Walker centers on Cordell Walker, a widower and father of two with his own moral code, who returns home to Austin after being undercover for two years, only to discover there's harder work to be done at home. He attempts to reconnect with his children, navigate clashes with his conservative family, and find unexpected common ground with his new partner (one of the first women in Texas Rangers' history), while growing increasingly suspicious about the circumstances surrounding his wife's death.
title: Walker

overview: Each episode of Disney Fam Jam featuring two families hitting the floor in three unique rounds of dance battles to see which family will be crowned Disney Fam Jam Champs.
title: Disney Fam Jam

overview: Did the Maya Empire relocate to America? How did Meriwether Lewis really die? Where did the Ark of the Covenant end up after being smuggled out of Jerusalem? Explorers Justin Fornal and Emiliano Ruprah use historical maps as well as modern imaging techniques to examine these and other mysteries.
title: Unexplained and Unexplored

overview: David Chang is accompanied by a different celebrity guest exploring a single city, its culture and its cuisine. As the pair travels through each city, they will also uncover new and surprising things about themselves.
title: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

overview: Rugal is about an elite detective who attempts to bring down a nationwide criminal organization named Argos. In the process, he ends up being targeted by the powerful criminals behind Argos, and not only does he lose his beloved wife and both of his eyes, but he is also framed for murder. After receiving a set of artificial eyes with special abilities created using biotechnology developed by an organization named Rugal, he sets out on a quest to wipe out the criminal organization responsible for his suffering.
title: Rugal

overview: XIII: The Series is a follow up to the TV movie: XIII: The Prodigy. A man suffering from amnesia tries to uncover his past in this action filled canadian show.
title: XIII: The Series

overview: Six brides-to-be must pass off an undercover actor as a real member of their bridal party in a bid to win their dream honeymoon.
title: Bad Bridesmaid

overview: America the Beautiful tells the story of the frontier and wildlife closest to America's heart. We explore the woods that Davy Crocket once called home in the Great Valley of Appalachia, and where Wild Bill Hickok saw his last sunset in the Badlands of South Dakota.
title: America the Beautiful: Wild Frontier

overview: When one thinks of dominant animals that roam the earth, large predators--lions, grizzlies and titanic anacondas come to mind. But, pound for pound, the most powerful and awe-inspiring creatures are the elusive micro-monsters that exist just beneath our feet. Wildlife author and expert Bradley Trevor Greive and biodesigner Billy Almon venture to some of the most remote and inhospitable habitats in the world to track down these tiny beasts. Using state of the art equipment, they will measure the abilities of these creatures and present them in a way never seen before.
title: Little Giants

overview: Pariu cu viața centers upon the love story between two teenagers Ioana Popa and Andrei Anghel whose destinies are switched at birth. Ioana and Andrei are students in their senior year at the National College of Arts. They are happily in love or at least this is what Ioana thinks until the moment she learns shes nothing but a bet Andrei made with Cristi, his best friend. What nobody knows is that Andrei has truly fallen for her. Disappointed, Ioana takes refuge in music, especially in LaLa Band, the modern music club created by the new music teacher at the college, Raluca. The 20 talented members of LaLa Band promise to insert new adrenaline into the post-Beatles music. They all have a great passion for music and big dreams to become international stars and have sold out concerts. Ioana was raised in a poor family by Gica Popa and Tantica together with her brother, Rafael and her sister, Gio. With plenty of humor and always looking for fun, the Popas live by the motto education is not important, only money matters. Andrei is a charismatic young guy who comes from a wealthy family that seems to be perfect. But the truth starts to come up when Anca, Andreis sister, is diagnosed with a severe kidney disease, inherited from Mara Anghels family. Her only chance of survival is a kidney transplant. After running the blood tests, Mara and Sandu Anghel have to face another shocking truth: Andrei is revealed as not being related to Anca or the family at all. Mara and Sandu Anghel realize their child was switched at birth in the tragic fire that occurred at the maternity hospital 17 years ago. And they begin the search of their real child the child that could save Anca's life as well as their own.
title: Pariu cu viața

overview: O nouă viață is a sequel to the 2011 TV series Pariu cu viața and it's the first Romanian musical soap opera.
title: O nouă viață

overview: Florin Calinescu plays a loving mother, a widow, who, although she learns to love everything that moves in the lives of those around her, she loves above all her children, and the family is the most important thing in the world.
title: Tanti Florica

overview: Ana Mateescu knows that the fairy tale time has passed. A learned person over the last few years to face the responsibility of the lured staff in front of the adults is crying. She can barely remember the good times in care she has a happy family, a house of her own and she lived with her parents, grandmother and sister without anyone to worry about tomorrow. After the death of her father, a grandmother and mother's departure to Spain, other changes followed in Ana's life. A house lost in the nursing home, being needed to move with Simona, her younger sister, in their aunt's apartment, Nuta.
title: Ingeri Pierduti

overview: Ioana, a 23-year-old girl is suffering terribly after the death of her parents. She takes care of her sister, Raluca, making money from a bar, hiding this from her sister, lying to her that he is a psychologist. The situation becomes more difficult when Raluca falls in love with Dragoș, and her best friend falls in love with the same man. Ioana knows Stefan he falls in love with. He wants to get rid of his possessive mother's influence, asking for help from Ioana, believing that she is a psychologist. The boy's mother wants to marry Adina, who is fighting with Ioana for the boy's love. Zuzu, the owner of the bar where Ioana works, joins Ioana for better and for worse, both she and the other girls.
title: Iubire ca in filme

overview: The story centers around the Chivu and Predescu families. Unemployed and divorced Dan Chivu lives with his 17-year-old son, Oaki and his older brother, 40-year-old bachelor Valentin (Vali). Ambassador Predescu lives in a grand villa with his daughter Irina, 17-year-old granddaughter Simona and Anton Valet. Dan commits himself to the Predescu villa as a nurse! This is where the complications arise, because Dan has taken on a new identity, Mrs. Dana. Predescu does not support it and puts the nickname "Monkey with earrings". Oaki likes Simona, but she does not dare to reveal her feelings. Simona is together with Robert (the school basketball player) who is also wanted by Mădălina (Mădă), Simona's best friend. In the second season, things get complicated, because Dana is asked to marry Predescu and reveals her true identity. Predescu goes into a coma because of the shock, but he wakes up after a long time (in which Dan was worried that Predescu would never wake up again and that it might be his fault. sued him) with amnesia. Meanwhile, Oaki and Simona fall in love, but their love affair does not last long, due to a country girl, Maria, who falls in love with Oaki ... Simona desperately tries to give Robert's slippers to be his girlfriend to Oaki. It only succeeds when it is too late (Oaki and Maria being a couple), and Robert forms a relationship with Mădă. Also, Dan is forced to take on a third identity, the psychologist Tomescu, who makes daily meetings with the Predescu family. Other important characters would be Bobo, Oaki's childhood friend who despite his weight, always remembers that he would have friends and the director of the high school, nicknamed by children, Cruela. Bobo was the first to meet Maria (of course telling her friends about her as a girlfriend), having feelings for her. After failing with Maria, Bobo tries his luck with the most desirable girl in high school ... Simona. Cruel instead does not play much in the first season, it is only an obstacle in the execution of minor plans. In the second part, however, becoming Vali's girlfriend, she has a much bigger role. In the middle of the second season Eva appears, the lost and found daughter of Ambassador Predescu.
title: Nimeni nu-i perfect

overview: The first ever romanian TV show follows Dan Bratu and Bianca still dealing with Ioana Bratu's death, a beloved wife and mother.
title: Numai Iubirea

overview: Arestat la domiciliu presents the life of a typical Romanian family. The Dumitru family is so "normal" that after 15 years of marriage, the head of the family, Costica, is seriously thinking of fleeing the world. His wife, Nuti, is almost perfect, but in Costica's eyes he still has a small flaw: there is! Their two twins, Luca and Raluca, are diametrically opposed, they hate each other and stress their father with any trifle. And, as if two teenagers with problems were not enough in a house, a third child is on the way ... And Nuti's brother, Ion Bunescu, a religion teacher, recently married the woman of dreams his, Beatrice, a former "exotic dancer" that he brings more and more often to the house of the Dumitru family.
title: Arestat la domiciliu

overview: Children in Need provide grants to projects in the UK which focus on children and young people who are disadvantaged. We are local to people in all corners of the UK and support small and large organisations which empower children and extend their life choices. The BBC Children in Need Appeal Night takes place every year in November. The Appeal show is a whole evening of entertainment on BBC One with celebrities singing, dancing, and doing all sorts of crazy things to help raise money.
title: BBC Children in Need

overview: A woman gets to live at her biological mother's boarding house with her stepmother after her father dies and his business goes down. This struggling family overcomes life challenges together through love and compassion to reach a happy ending.
title: Mother's Garden

overview: Alex Puica, a young man that seems to be followed by trouble and bad luck, is soon to marry Maria, daughter of the respectable Emilian and Natalia Codrescu.
title: O Săptămână Nebună

overview: Take Me to Your Mother follows Andrea Rosen as she meets moms from different parts of society and with different backgrounds, learning about how to best raise her children.
title: Take Me to Your Mother

overview: America from Scratch showcases the best the internet has to offer, while celebrating the impact of public media.
title: America from Scratch

overview: Leavenworth is centered on Clint Lorance, who's serving a 19-year sentence for murder at The United States Penitentiary, Leavenworth. While deployed in Afghanistan in July 2012, the former lieutenant ordered fire on three local men riding a motorcycle, killing two of them and outraging his platoon. In a first-hand account of a soldier navigating the U.S. Army's legal system, Lorance seeks to overturn his conviction, provoking emotional debate between supporters and detractors that rises to the national stage. As determinations on Lorance's fate unfold, questions probe not only the merits of his conviction, but analyze the system at large and ultimately test the balance of guilt and innocence in the inscrutable circumstances of today's wars.
title: Leavenworth

overview: Lena has reconciled herself with the old-age job, but life at home is becoming increasingly complicated. Lena and Morten's plan to maintain a normal and relatively harmonious relationship becomes difficult to implement because Anemone wants full control over Morten and Lena at a long distance. At the same time, Lena continues the pursuit of love!
title: Best før

overview: It's sexy. It's racy. It's India's hottest original show.
title: XXX: Uncensored

overview: A story of graduates from a co-ed school reuniting after 30 years and facing reality reflected by their past.
title: Love Again

overview: Park Tae Joon is an intelligent law student and a filial son to his parents who runs a mill. His has a younger brother, Tae Soo not quite as academic still quite smart and a known brat in town, and a younger sister, the kind and gentle-hearted Sun Hee. From the same town as Tae Joon, Kim Mi Ja, his love interest is sick and tired of living in poverty and desires to leave their small town for a better life. One day after their father's death, the family learns that they will lose their home as a pledge due to an assurance their father has made before his death. From the poverty stricken post war era of the 1950s to the modern times of Korea, this TV drama follows a family and the surrounding characters who rode the drastic changes with passion.
title: Love and Ambition

overview: Park Tae Joon is an intelligent law student and a filial son to his parents who run a mill. He has a younger brother, Tae Soo, who is not quite as academic, but still quite smart and a known brat in town, and a younger sister, the kind and gentle-hearted Sun Hee. Kim Mi Ja, Tae Joon's love interest, is from the same town and is sick and tired of living in poverty. She desires to leave their small town for a better life. One day after their father's death, the family learns that they will lose their home as a pledge due to an assurance their father has made before his death.
title: Love and Ambition

overview: Jung Hee's husband affair had twisted his mistress's fate so tightly together with his wife, that even his death did not break the cruel bond between the two woman. Now years later, will history repeat itself once more when the women meet again? Can these two women break free of hate to love again?
title: Love and Hate

overview: After the breakdown of the old government, and with it the First Republic, Italy changed for good in 1994. Spinster Leo is all too aware of this. He pushed hard to see Berlusconi get elected Prime Minister. He knows it's not easy to win power, but holding on to it verges on the impossible. By the same token, it seems equally impossible for populist politician Pietro to change. Even now that he has an office at the Prime Minister's premises in Rome, he still can't cast off his old bad habits. Nor can he forget the only woman he has ever loved. A former TV starlet now turned politician and Congresswoman, Veronica has to decide who the man of her life is going to be. She has realized she no longer wants to be just a woman on the arm of powerful men. It is the start of her own push for power.

Ever wonder what "the cloud" a.k.a. the internet actually looks like? Or why memes look the way they do? Our crew rides four-wheelers into a desert, meets with an orthopedic surgeon who was struck by lightning, and tracks down the world's leading experts to answer these questions and more.
title: Glad You Asked

overview: Dudley is a dragon who recently woke up from centuries of hibernation. He meets his new ten-year-old friends Matt and Sally as well as other kids down the line. The many kids guide Dudley around the modern world and the trio learn about environmentalism, friendship and pro-social values.
title: The Adventures of Dudley the Dragon

overview: Determination wins games, but Detail wins championships...
title: Detail: From the Mind of Kobe Bryant

overview: Lauren (Eve Myles) and Ed (Anthony Head) are madly in love, despite their almost 30-year age gap, and are looking forward to starting their new life living together. The only problem is that Lauren's family and everyone around them seems to have an opinion on the subject. With Ed's ex-wife Lydia renting the house opposite and trying to cause trouble whenever she can, Lauren's meddling family and Ed's friends all thinking she's a trophy girlfriend; their relationship will have to be ironclad to weather these obstacles they're facing.
title: You, Me & Them

overview: Every year more than 120,000 people disappear without a trace in Russia. Someone went into the forest and got lost, someone left work, but never made it home. TV-3 project "Returned" will tell real stories about people who have been found, and about those who are still looking for...
title: Вернувшиеся

overview: The Fred Waring Show includes performances by his orchestra and large chorus, as well as dancing and sketches.
title: The Fred Waring Show

overview: Office Watch is about what goes on in an office, showing the main characters struggling with a variety of very difficult coworkers but also captures blooming office romance.
title: Office Watch

overview: The toughest cases, biggest celebrities and genuine disputes can only be settled by one man, radio shock jock Kyle Sandilands. Kyle will pass judgement across a whole range of real life cases. Helping him analyze the evidence once again will be former The Bachelor Australia star and criminal lawyer Anna Heinrich.
title: Trial by Kyle

overview: MIXTAPE puts the spotlight on a different rock icon each week as they sit down to discuss their favorite songs and share their own personal "mixtape" of meaningful music that shaped their lives and careers. Filmed in the landmark Gibson Guitar Showroom in Hollywood, California, MIXTAPE gives viewers an exclusive interview with some of rock's most iconic figures where they tell the story of their lives through the songs that they love. MIXTAPE is also packed with surprise appearances and unplugged performances. MIXTAPE is the ultimate classic rock experience that music lovers of all ages will not want to miss.
title: MIXTAPE

overview: How to survive if nothing is left? Is it possible to start life anew in a strange city where no one needs you? How to find the strength to go further and not let circumstances and your own fears break you? The life of Marina Romanova was like a fairy tale, which every woman dreams of - a loving husband, little son, a country house and a successful business. But in the yard the end of the 90s, and a difficult time makes its own adjustments. Marina's beautiful life disappears in one moment, just as an incoming wave washes away a wonderful sand castle ...
title: Замок из песка

overview: Dr. Lauren Thielen is back home in Texas to open her very own exotic animal practice, located alongside one of the state's largest and busiest animal hospitals. With the support of the 24/7 emergency room staff, and more than a dozen specialists, she treats everything from emus to hedgehogs, and whatever else comes through the door. Dr. Thielen will deliver dramatic and heartwarming stories of animals in need, all with her Texas-sized dose of charm we've all come to love. Join Dr. T on her journey to create her own legacy as she follows her dreams.
title: Dr. T, Lone Star Vet

overview: The second German in-house production of the pay TV station 13th Street is a classic, black-humored crime thriller in a modern guise.
title: Prost Mortem – Die letzte Runde

overview: In Brizan, a quiet seaside resort in the french Landes, everything changes with the arrival of the first wave which, like a tsunami, will cause the disappearance of surfers and disrupt the intimate life of the inhabitants.
title: La Dernière Vague

overview: Following the hapless staff of the fictional bargain supermarket chain Valco in Warrington.
title: Trollied

overview: The series tells the story of a group of police officers from the police station of Genoa, that belong to the Flying Squad, whose job it is to capture the fugitives. 48 hours represent the time limit beyond which a fugitive's tracks are likely to be lost. In order to operate in such a short amount of time agents are sourced with the most diverse skills as possible.
title: 48 ore

overview: Run the World is the story of a group of Black, vibrant, fiercely loyal best friends who work, live and play in Harlem as they strive for world domination. At its core, it's an unapologetically female show about enviable friendship and not only surviving—but thriving together.
title: Run the World

overview: Many Ultramarines leave their territories whether for their studies, the creation of a business, desires elsewhere, the impossibility of exercising their talents at home or by sexual orientation. If the reasons for their departure are indeed multiple, what are the triggering factors? How do these Ultramarines choose the host country, remoteness, integration and success when the overseas territories do not necessarily have the means to retain their children. Six Ultramarines have agreed to testify and tell their new life.
title: Ultramarins, ultraterriens

overview: Exit 57 is a sketch comedy show starring alumni from Second City: Stephen Colbert, Amy Sedaris, Paul Dinello, among others.
title: Exit 57

overview: Two best friends' relationship is strained when they fall in love with the same man.
title: Another Me

overview: Each episode of The Hustler follows five contestants as they collaborate to answer a series of trivia questions, with the goal of building a collective prize pot that increases with each correct answer. The catch? One of the five contestants, the Hustler, already knows the answers but must keep their identity a secret in order to have a shot at winning the grand prize. Throughout each episode, two contestants are anonymously eliminated by the Hustler, leaving three remaining contestants – the Hustler and two others, who must collectively decide who they think the Hustler is. If they are right, they share the prize pot. If the two contestants are wrong, the Hustler goes home with the full cash reward.
title: The Hustler

overview: Stille Waters was a Flemish drama series commissioned by VRT-TV1. This 2001 co-production between TV1 (now: one; first network of the Flemish public broadcaster) and Fonds Film in Vlaanderen (now: VAF; Vlaams Audiovisueel Fonds) pushes the boundaries of television fiction by spreading a long haunting story over 13 episodes. The heroic battle between a powerful industrialist (Alex Vorlat) and a young woman (Jana Meyer) who goes in search of the cause of her father's death creates haunting drama along the banks of the Scheldt in the region of Klein-Brabant.
title: Stille Waters

overview: Adventurer and nature lover Ray Mears explores some of Britain's more inaccessible countryside to discover the wildlife living just outside our front door.
title: Wild Britain with Ray Mears

overview: Joseon X-Files is based on cases detailed in the Annals of Joseon History with a bizarre twist; these incidents incorporate mysterious, supernatural elements that cannot be explained through science. Kim Hyung Do is an inspector of the state whose single-minded focus on his investigations into administrative misdeeds bring him into direct contact with these strange mysteries. Heo Yoon Yi is a government employee who aids him and attempts to understand these scientific impossibilities with an open mind, in contrast to his cynicism.
title: Joseon X-Files: Mystery Investigation Record

overview: "The Therapist" has nothing on Dr. Blackson…as in the unfiltered and unbothered comedian, Michael Blackson. Have issues in the bedroom, with body image, or your sexual orientation? Come to Dr. Blackson and he will fix you like that. But is he kind, gentle, and caring? Hell, no. Get your mind right or else, modasucka! This series is the natural next step for Michael's hugely popular ‘advice column' on his Social Media pages, where random people write to Michael with their problems, then await his usually outrageous advice.
title: Dr. Blackson

overview: A period drama set in 1930s Los Angeles that follows the life of private investigator Miles C. Banyon, a tough-but-honest detective who would accept essentially any case for US$20/day.
title: Banyon

overview: Nakia follows full-blooded Navajo Nakia Parker, a deputy sheriff in the fictional town of Concord in fictional Davis County in 1974 New Mexico. Nakia balances ancient tribal customs and the use of modern police methods which occasionally leads to opposition from his more narrow-minded white neighbors--including his boss, Sheriff Jericho.
title: Nakia

overview: N.Y.P.D. follows three New York police detectives as they solve a wide range of crimes and arrest criminals. The show features many real New York City locations, as well as episodes based on actual New York City police cases.
title: N.Y.P.D.

overview: Could You Survive the Movies? explores the science behind classic movies, breaking down scenes and images to explain what they would look like in the real world.
title: Could You Survive the Movies?

overview: Finding Alice is a drama series about a woman who loses her husband in a freak accident only to find he has left her to unravel a trail of secrets, debt and criminality.
title: Finding Alice

overview: Ted Lasso centers on an idealistic — and clueless — all-American football coach hired to manage an English football club — despite having no soccer coaching experience at all.
title: Ted Lasso

overview: After six months of online flirting, a neurotic pharmaceutical copywriter named Gavin and a printing press employee named Stacey decide to meet -- with their best friends in tow. While Gavin lives in a New York apartment right below his parents, Stacey lives with her widowed mother, Gwen, in a tiny Pennsylvania town. Gwen is unnerved by her daughter's online relationship, as is Stacey's uncle, Brian, who has taken on the role of family protector. Gavin's mother lacks a filter and volume control, and his father unrealistically considers himself the family's voice of reason. As Stacey and Gavin try to make their relationship work, they learn that their family and friends turn out to be the biggest complications. Us & Them is an American television series based on the British series Gavin & Stacey created by James Corden and Ruth Jones, adapted to an American audience by David J. Rosen. On October 11, 2013, it was revealed that Fox had cut back the episode order from thirteen to seven episodes. In summer 2014, Vulture revealed that Fox would not air the show. The series was first broadcast in South Africa on M-Net. Entire 7 episodes were available on Korean major IPTV networks. However, in September 2018, streaming service Sony Crackle announced it would be streaming all seven episodes starting October 1, finally giving the show its American release.
title: Us & Them

overview: Life and work in a police station of Rome. The chief of the station, Giovanna Scalise, has arrived in town after a long period passed in the city of Palermo, Sicily, where she fought against mafia.
title: Distretto di polizia

overview: Heading the judging table are internationally renowned chefs and restaurateurs Colin Fassnidge (My Kitchen Rules) and Judith Tabron, tasting their way through the team's culinary delights in the hopes of discovering New Zealand's best hidden gem. From traditional Italian fare in Nelson, paddock-to-plate-styled kai in Waiouru and delicious seafood in Christchurch, every restaurant offers something different - and this series will dish up mouth-watering food in restaurants that viewers can visit and try themselves. The first round of the competition sees Colin, Judith and the teams visit each restaurant where they eat an entrée, main and dessert, before eliminating the team with the lowest score. Round two begins with the four remaining teams being given $20,000 and 72 hours to renovate their restaurant's interior and menu before hosting again for the second time. This time, they're not only hosting the judges and other teams, but also local restaurateurs and food critics. After some advice from Colin, it will be time to see who's learnt the most and improved, with the bottom two teams being eliminated before the Grand Final. The Grand Final takes place over consecutive nights, with the final two teams battling it out for the title and incredible cash prize. With their restaurants open to the public and the pressure of cooking a three-course meal for a full house – which team will crumble, and which team will be told their restaurant rules?
title: My Restaurant Rules

overview: Four teams make over each other's homes to see who has the best taste in interior design.
title: Your Room or Mine?

overview: No more bad meals, or at least you'll have less of them. MUNCHIES presents a series of guides to eating in some of the best, most exciting, or most underrated food destinations around the world.
title: MUNCHIES Guide to...

overview: Legendary Italian cellist Mario Brunello prepares to play in the middle of the Dolomites in one of the highlights of the high-altitude summer festival in Trentino, Italy.
title: Sounds of the Dolomites

overview: Grease: Rise of the Pink Ladies is inspired by the 1978 Golden Globe® nominated film Grease. A joyous musical series set in and around the world of Rydell High, the show reimagines the global smash hit movie with some characters you already know, and a whole lot more you will soon meet. It's still the 1950s, a world that rocks with big musical numbers from the period combined with new original songs as well. It's the peer pressures of high school, the horrors of puberty, and the rollercoaster of life in middle America with a modern sensibility that will bring it to life for today's musical lovers.
title: Grease: Rise of the Pink Ladies

overview: To evade an admirer, Tine plays up a relationship with a pretend boyfriend, Sarawat, until the act turns to reality. Adapted from JittiRain's novel.
title: 2gether The Series

overview: A 6-part documentary following the Benetton Formula 1 team through the 1997 F1 World Championship season.
title: A Year in the Fast Lane

overview: When Roberto Ardenzi is promoted to police chief, he finds himself managing a new group of strong-willed policemen afflicted by personal problems, as well as trying to reconcile work with his private life, especially in the relationship with his twenty-year-old daughter Mauretta.
title: Squadra mobile
Czego się boją faceci, czyli seks w mniejszym mieście

overview: A volunteer teacher dies in a tragic accident, in which her heart is transplanted to Tian. Through a series of diary entries Tian learns about her life; her secrets and interests. Including her promise to military officer Phupha, about counting a thousand stars with him. Tian then decides to follow in her footsteps and complete her dream. With Tian a new volunteer teacher, he attempts to befriend Phupha. Yet, Phupha gives off a cold exterior. Slowly the two grow close, but Tian's heart beats fast around the military officer. As he starts to fall for him, much like its previous owner did. But with the area being war-ridden and dangerous, can they keep their thousand-star promise?
title: A Tale of Thousand Stars

overview: A housewife who has gone through a stormy marriage and a man with an upbeat personality who also weathered a tough times try to "reset" their lives.
title: Unasked Family

overview: All is not what it appears at Lizzie's new school. There's something seriously spooky about the strange Headmaster and Lizzie is determined to find out what's going on, before it's too late.
title: The Demon Headmaster

overview: When pater familias Jack Praal is confronted with his biggest fear and his youngest son is associated with a murder of a woman, the family will be taken into a web of intrigues and betrayal. A battle in which the family is trying their best to stay close to each other, but is almost impossible to hold on to.
title: Swanenburg

overview: Using jaw-dropping footage recorded by those on board, this series straps you in for a roller-coaster ride.
title: World's Worst Flights

overview: A fujoshi who is a hard shipper had an accident and her soul got into Kim's body. She takes advantage of the situation to make her ship sails while Kim's brother notices that his brother is not the same.
title: The Shipper

overview: Prince Charles: Inside the Duchy of Cornwall is a series with privileged access to Prince Charles and his private domain, the Duchy of Cornwall, the ancient Royal estate which he has built up over the last 50 years into a billion pound business to support himself, his immediate family and his charities.
title: Prince Charles: Inside the Duchy of Cornwall

overview: In Chain Letters, three contestants compete to win money by changing letters in words to form new words.
title: Chain Letters

overview: Twelve co-workers of the call center of the online shop "Boutique for Adults" are trapped on the 12th floor of the Gloria Plaza business center in Moscow. Suddenly the intruders named "mom" and "dad" tell them that the building is mined. For a bomb not to explode, the workers must comply with the criminals' demands. Will the hostages be able to defuse the bomb in 8 hours, escape and still remain humans?
title: Колл-центр

overview: A beautiful love story between two young adults. Is it going to be the love of his life or the dream of his life? based on the novel My Poplar in a Red Scarf by Chinghiz Aitmatov and the Turkish romantic drama film The Girl with the Red Scarf.
title: Al Yazmalim
